record.name: Slicer
record.description: Slicers are masters of computer systems and digital networks, using their hacking skills to infiltrate secure databases, manipulate systems, and extract valuable information.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Master of digital networks and computer systems.
visual_signals: Digital blue glow around eyes when hacking

progression_tree.description: You can use your proficiency bonus to add to an ability check you make to interact with a computer system.

effects.value: Add Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks related to digital systems

progression_tree.description: You can hack into a device and gain temporary access, allowing you to extract information or disable security measures.

effects.value: Gain temporary access to device and add Proficiency Bonus to skill checks related to device

progression_tree.description: You can create a digital backdoor in a system, allowing you to access it remotely.

effects.value: Create digital backdoor and gain access to system from anywhere

progression_tree.description: You can use your hacking skills to create a convincing digital identity, allowing you to infiltrate secure systems.

effects.value: Create convincing digital identity and gain access to secure systems

progression_tree.description: You can use your hacking skills to disrupt the security measures of a system, allowing you to bypass even the most secure defenses.

effects.value: Disrupt security measures and gain full access to system

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a defensive stance, with lightsaber at the ready and eyes scanning for potential threats.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Projects a calming aura of blue-green energy that seems to soothe nearby allies and deter enemies.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A lone Jedi Master stands on a cliff overlooking a desert planet, surrounded by swirling clouds of sand and heat haze.
